GENERAL SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics.

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrolysis? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electrolysis.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrolysis.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrolysis.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrolysis.

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell division? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell division.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell division.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cell division.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell division.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Polymers? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Polymers.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Polymers.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Polymers.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Polymers.

13. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

14. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution and Biodiversity? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution and Biodiversity.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution and Biodiversity.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution and Biodiversity.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution and Biodiversity.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Polymers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Electrolysis and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Electrostatics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
